images.name: native-open-v3.png
images.evidence: The open synthetic-smb-relationships.pcapng view shows frames 1–18 with no display filter applied, and the status bar reads Packets: 18. Three TCP/SMB exchanges are visible.

images.name: native-smb-filter-v3.png
images.evidence: The green display-filter bar reads smb2 && ip.addr == 192.0.2.21. The packet list contains exactly frames 4, 5, 10, 11, 16 and 17; the status bar reports 18 packets and 6 displayed.

images.name: native-request-detail-v3.png
images.evidence: Frame 4 is selected, from 192.0.2.21 to 192.0.2.40 at relative time 0.030000. The expanded SMB2 Tree Connect Request visibly contains Tree: \\192.0.2.40\TeamDocs.

images.name: native-response-detail-v3.png
images.evidence: Frame 5 is selected, from 192.0.2.40 to 192.0.2.21. The expanded SMB2 header visibly shows STATUS_SUCCESS (0x00000000), Message ID: 1, Tree Id: 0x00000001 and Response to: 4, with the TeamDocs share association.

images.name: native-ipv4-conversations-v3.png
images.evidence: The IPv4 tab is selected and Limit to display filter is unchecked. Three full-file pairs are visible: 192.0.2.21–192.0.2.40 with 6 packets and 526 bytes; 192.0.2.70–192.0.2.21 with 6 packets and 522 bytes; and 192.0.2.21–192.0.2.22 with 6 packets and 532 bytes. Relative starts, durations and directional counters are visible.
